subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Bold
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'Timid.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

 
 
• Bold- brave, or without fear.
 
• Timid- easily frightened; not brave or confident.
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
 
 
• Soft- not hard or firm.
 
• Tired- in need of rest or sleep.
 
• Harsh- unpleasant, unkind, cruel, or more severe than necessary.
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Bold' and 'Timid' are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 1.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the synonyms and antonyms for the given word 'Bold':

 
• Synonyms: adventurous, audacious, courageous, daring, fearless, heroic.
 
• Antonyms: afraid, cautious, cowardly, fearful, meek, shy.

1d
